name: Akasen Gairo ~Shouwa 33 Nen no Hatsuyuki~
original_name: 赤線街路～昭和33年の初雪～
source:
After the war, there were several districts where people are allowed to open a brothel. The main character is Masayuki. He comes to one of the districts to look for his mother, but he can't find her, and is at a loss what to do. Shizue, a brothel prostitute, takes care of him, and he begins to stay at her house.... What will he think when he meets his mother?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090430130502/http://web.archive.org/web/20090415125925/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008473]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
战后，有几个区域允许开设妓院。主人公是雅之。他来到其中一个区域寻找母亲，但找不到她，不知如何是好。妓院妓女静江照顾了他，他开始住在她家里……当他遇到母亲时，他会怎么想？
